set.issuer: Disney Store (shopDisney successor, disneystore.com) - celebrates Walt Disney Animation Studios artwork
set.format: Ongoing 2026 series: monthly Limited Edition single pins (pin-on-pin, finished character over artist sketch, 3D Mickey-glove-with-brushes icon) plus quarterly Mystery Pin Blind Pack series (2 random pins per box from 10 designs)
set.total_pins_in_set: Not officially stated as a fixed total. Found so far (to 2026-10-13): 18 LE single/jumbo items + 30 mystery designs (3 series x 10) = 48 designs. Early listing wording '1 of 12', later '1 of 16 monthly + 4 quarterly' suggests plan expanded; series likely still ongoing.

release_waves.items: Genie, Gadget, Mickey on Animator's Desk jumbo 2-pc

set.price: LE singles USD 24.99 (UK Marie GBP 16.00); mystery boxes USD 34.99 / GBP 25.00 per 2-pin box
set.regions: Disney Store US online primarily; Disney Store UK lists Marie and Mystery Series 1 & 3. One fan source says mystery series sold in US, UK, Europe & Asia Disney Stores. No Disneyland Paris or Disney Parks (WDW/DLR) in-park release found, despite one search summary mentioning 'WDW, DLR'.

research_notes: All direct page fetches (WebFetch and curl) failed: the session egress proxy denies CONNECT to disneystore.com, disneystore.co.uk, disneypinsblog.com, wdwinfo.com, wdwnt.com, extramagicminutes.com, dismerchandise.com. No attempt was made to circumvent. All facts come from WebSearch result summaries of those pages, so even 'official' facts are second-hand via the search engine; re-verify against live product pages before importing into the Master Catalogue. Brush of Magic is a Disney Store (online) line, not a Disney Parks or Disneyland Paris line; no DLP/ED92/DLP Report coverage found. UK relevance: Disney Store UK sold Marie (GBP 16) and Mystery Series 1 & 3 (GBP 25/box). Conflicts: Jan pins LE 2,250 vs 3,750; Cinderella 3,750 (official) vs 2,000 (blog); Darkwing 3,750 vs 3,250; Mickey jumbo 3,749 vs 3,750; Hades date 06-02 vs 06-23; Gadget date 10-06 vs 10-13; release ordinal numbering differs between blogs. No chasers reported for any Disney Store mystery series. Captain Hook and Ariel rest on a single fan source. Name collision: PALM 'Ink and Paint Brush of Magic' mystery set (Nov 2025) is a separate product.
time_and_difficulty: About 20 search calls; moderate difficulty. Main obstacle was the network policy blocking every page fetch, forcing reliance on search-engine summaries (risk of summarisation errors). Coverage of LE singles and mystery checklists is good; per-pin SKUs, Series 2 official listing, and Aug 2026 wave are weak.
